Name: Fortunatus
Summary: Fortunatus was one of the Corinthian brethren who came to Paul and supplied what was lacking from the church, refreshing Paul's spirit.
KeyStory: Fortunatus was one of the Corinthian brethren who came to Paul and supplied what was lacking from the church, refreshing Paul's spirit.
LifeLesson: A messenger who carries a church's care refreshes the one who receives it.
